name: Create a document from a template

elements.name: Select an assembly template in list view

steps.name: the new-document template chooser is open in the MCAD Software
the metric template folder is selected
the user chooses List in the template display menu
the gallery displays compact template entries under type headings
the template details pane remains visible
the user selects the standard metric assembly template in the list
the details pane identifies an assembly with millimeter units
the user chooses Medium icons in the template display menu
the gallery displays medium-sized template icons
the details pane continues to identify the metric assembly template
